question: Does a specific sparse non-pairwise pawn condition add held-out information beyond matched additive pawn geometry after calibration?
objective: Existing search-pawn CE on fixed trained affine baseline, plus.125 times new features; identical settings and data in both arms.
resource: One bounded BelowNormal process, timeout300seconds, only between match batches; no owner writes or model export.
selection: Report both fixed arms and all four evaluation halves. A positive fit is not admission to architecture/training or proof of useful chess information.
rationale: G9 fixes calibration yet compact degree signals remain small and panel-dependent. Passed-pawn conjunction offers a distinct sparse information basis and an explicit pairwise control. It is separate from the prior broad visibility pilot.
